digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler binding and create deduplication
propositions: Under Jira DC with Lucene index lag, a crash during create_issue produces a keyless-pending binding entry that recover_pending cannot confirm as written because the issue is not yet indexed
recover_pending's keyless-branch search misses on an unindexed-but-live issue and unbinds the entry, removing the only record that would prevent create_one from issuing a duplicate
create_one's dedup search also misses the unindexed issue and creates a second Jira issue, violating the write-ahead binding protocol

Fixing only recover_pending to leave the entry pending is insufficient because get_jira_key(local_id) still returns None for keyless-pending entries, so the create gate in outbound_differ never consults is_pending()
The duplicate-preventing fix must gate the create at dispatch_one.create_one by deferring (not dropping) creation while a keyless-pending binding exists within an index-lag grace window
Unbinding must require corroboration: both search_miss_count >= 3 AND entry age > grace period (default 3600s), converting a silent duplicate into a delayed-but-correct answer
